newsitem.title: USA: Neopath to install two AutoPap systems.
newsitem.headline: Neopath to install two AutoPap systems.

text.p: NeoPath Inc said on Friday it reached an agreement with ARUP Laboratories to install two AutoPap 300 QC Systems, which screen Pap smears, at the lab's Salt Lake City, Utah facility.

ARUP Laboratories, which processes about 70,000 Pap smears a year, plans to run 100 percent of the Pap smears originally classified as normal through the AutoPap QC Systems as part of quality assurance, NeoPath said.
NeoPath's system uses high-speed image processing computers, video imaging technology and image interpretation software to capture and analyze microscopic images from a Pap smear slide.
